author: Mehrp
body:
Because the avicus email still hasn't responded, and neither has darkiur (the mod who banned me), I've been forced to put the appeal here:  The ban is only 3 days but nonetheless I don't think I did. I have, unfortunately, forgotten any incident where I have logged out when I was about to be killed. The only way I'd accept this infraction is if I had video proof, then that'd assure me that I did. Because although I forgot the incident, I know that I'm aware of these minor infractions. Since the Jr mods have come on as well, you need to be exemplary because those guys really are like robots. I think the closest I've gotten to combat logging is where I was running along a bridge, avg popped up about some restart required, and I fell off. I then left. I wasn't in PvP was I? Therefore it is not 'combat' logging, I had not encountered anyone. This 'not-combat-logging-yet-still-logging-out' might have been the cause for my infraction, and as I am applying for mod and false infractions could be my downfall.

Also, one last thing; can you reply adding whether 'not-combat-logging' is allowed, as I fear that a misunderstanding of the rules may be the cause-it does only seem fair in a logical persons eyes that if you fell of while not in combat that you should not be punished. Also, if this is another false infraction then half of my infractions will be so. This is quite an annoyance for me, and the people who are also in my situation, I was wondering whether it would be possible do appeal my 'autoclicking' as there is a second ban rule where you basically can't appeal a second ban. As my first false ban was handled so well (thanks, dubby) and is now appealed, I thought that it may be possible to negotiate an appeal for that ban.

-half-regards, Merp.

(Yes copied from my email, I had to leave in a hurry when I posted this)

title: An appeal for combat logging

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to accept your appeal. Due to the lack of video evidence.

Regards,
LegendaryEngram, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
